name: Narmada Gelatines Limited
about: Narmada Gelatines Limited manufactures and sells gelatine and related products in India and internationally. The company's products include ossein and di-calcium phosphate. Its products have applications in food and beverage, pharmaceutical, photography, biomedical, cosmetic, nutraceuticals and dietary supplements, and industrial areas. Narmada Gelatines Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Jabalpur, India.
